## Madhav Prashanth Ramachandran

I stare at numbers and figure out what they mean.

Twelve years in AI/ML. The deeper I go, the more I realize I know nothing.
So I work through it publicly — one topic, one derivation at a time.

The power of seeing resonates with me more than the power of words.
Language describes the world. For me, images are the world.
